name: Ira
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Ira (also called Iri) was a descendant of Benjamin, the youngest son of Jacob. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Bela, the firstborn of Benjamin. He was a family head among the Benjamites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ira is listed as one of the sons of Bela, son of Benjamin, in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Family Head Among the Benjamites
keyEvents.description: Ira is counted among the family heads in the tribe of Benjamin, who were brave warriors. His clan was numbered at 22,034 men.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Benjamin in the Genealogies
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Benjamin is thoroughly documented in Chronicles, and Ir is part of this important tribal history that links the identity of the Israelites to their ancestors.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Bela as Tribal Leaders
keyEvents.description: Bela's sons, including Ir, served as leaders and chieftains in the tribe of Benjamin and helped shape the tribe's identity and strength.
